issuing_body: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
prohibited_practices: exploitation of vulnerabilities of specific groups
real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement (with limited exceptions)
untargeted scraping of facial images for recognition databases
emotion recognition in workplace and education
enforcement_authorities: national competent authorities designated by Member States
compliance_deadlines: Prohibited practices: 6 months after entry into force (approx. February 2025)
GPAI model obligations: 12 months after entry into force (approx. August 2025)
High-risk AI systems (Annex I): 24 months after entry into force (approx. August 2026)
High-risk AI systems (Annex I, certain sectors): 36 months after entry into force (approx. August 2027)
penalties_summary: Up to €35 million or 7% of global annual turnover for violations of prohibited practices; up to €15 million or 3% for other violations; up to €7.5 million or 1.5% for supplying incorrect information. SME/startup penalties scaled proportionately.
implementation_notes: Regulation entered into force 20 days after publication (1 August 2024) with phased applicability. Complements existing EU law on data protection, product safety, consumer protection, and employment. Does not affect GDPR or Directive 2016/680 obligations. European AI Office established within Commission to oversee GPAI models. Member States must designate national competent authorities.
